description: This file defines the ProjectReport class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin module. It implements report generation logic for project time reports, including request parameter parsing, validation rules, header and filter definitions, and access control. The class interacts with various components of the OrangeHRM framework to produce project-related report data based on filters like project ID and date range.

classes.name: ProjectReport
classes.description: This class handles the generation of project time reports within the OrangeHRM system, including parsing request parameters, validation, defining report header and filters, fetching report data, and enforcing access control.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Parses and prepares filter parameters from the incoming request, including project ID, date range, and include timesheet flag.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters such as project ID and date range, ensuring data integrity and proper constraints.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Constructs the header definition for the report, including columns for activity name and time in hours.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Provides the filter definition for the report, allowing filtering options for the report data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches and returns report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access the project report; throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.
